module_docstring: SNI-local DRAFT contract for the US/Mag-7 residual-transfer study (family sni.us_transfer.RESID-DIR-US). DRAFT ONLY: registered is false, outcome is none, the S0 protocol register is not edited, and nothing is sealed. This module CONSUMES owner-supplied values from Data OS identity, Company Event/Earnings, FIF, Capital Structure, Stock Identity, Options, Research Vault, and qledger/Evaluation. It does not fork or re-implement those owners. Canonical issuer and security identifiers are caller-supplied opaque strings owned by Stock Identity / Data OS; unknown identity stays UNRESOLVED / null; this draft never constructs an identifier from a ticker, name, code, CIK, FIGI or ISIN.
registration_note: This draft registers nothing; registration is gated by S0 register §2 and the R1 Chairman gate.

engine_citations.note: Line numbers are from origin/main at draft time via grep of the named symbols. This draft cites them and does not call them. s1_prereg.py ENGINE_CITATIONS used L202 for log_declared_budget; on this origin/main the same symbol sits at L204. S0 is never edited.

cohort.role: STRESS test of the METHOD mechanics (does it run, abstain, count and disclose correctly). Any result on these names is never evidence that a residual effect transfers, and is never representative of US large caps.
cohort.bridge_required_for_transfer_claim: a point-in-time, outcome-free cohort rule (for example top-N by then-known market cap at each split start)

Secondary sector bench is declared only where the ETF parquet exists in the origin/main listing (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA -> XLK; AMZN/TSLA -> XLY; GOOGL/META -> XLC). benches.never: Never back-fill a missing or not-then-known ETF with a later-created fund or a constituent reconstruction.

p01_copy.residual_construction: excess = subject_ret - bench_ret, simple returns on the owner's split-adjusted TR close (grade_claim convention, qledger L2698); each leg reproduces _leg_ret_in_window. hit = (sign(excess) == direction); excess == 0 exactly -> non-hit, listed as a tie; direction 0 -> ABSTAIN (listed, not a hit, not a miss).

baselines.trail63: sign of trailing-63-session excess at D(s); both series need bars on D and D63 exactly else direction 0

register_row_citation.pre_registered_null: H0₁: hit rate = 0.50 per horizon. H0₂: median excess = 0.

multiplicity.rule: Holm across the 21 cells for any TESTED label
multiplicity.tested_requires: min_clusters >= 2 and honest-N of distinct non-overlapping units
multiplicity.unestimable: ABSTAIN with a named reason; never a default 0.5 fill (A25)
multiplicity.historical_expectation: HISTORICAL-DESCRIPTIVE cells follow the SNI inference label rule; own-name power is the P01 descriptive case (153 episodes unreachable from one issuer). Holm applies only to cells labelled TESTED.

grading.emits: subject_ret, bench_ret, excess = subject_ret - bench_ret, hit
grading.surface_language: direction right/wrong over N matured beliefs
grading.n_is: IL honest-N, never a literal row count
grading.residual_is: DESCRIPTIVE, never causal, never news impact (A24)

identity.rule: Every name carries canonical_issuer_id null, security_id null, issuer_link UNRESOLVED, and the ticker only as a display label. Never construct an id from a ticker, name, CIK, FIGI or ISIN.
identity.per_cell: the same four identity fields are repeated on every cell

kill_retirement.p01_detail: Continue as a gated descriptive registration. The protocol becomes RETIRED-SUPERSEDED (a new version) if, 24 months after its first prospective registration, fewer than 20 units have matured and no cohort successor row exists. It is never re-scoped in place. (REG P01 detail block)
kill_retirement.kill_hold: a failed pre-declared criterion prints KILL/HOLD-AS-RESEARCH; it is never rescued by changing the target, cohort or horizon (s1_prereg.py kill_hold_rule; REG §5)
